mgmt_bio.text: David A. "Dave" Ricks is chair and chief executive officer of Eli Lilly and Company, having become CEO in January 2017 and chair of the board effective June 2017. He joined the company as a business development associate in 1996 and held roles spanning functions, geographies and therapeutic areas, serving as general manager of Lilly Canada, president and general manager of Lilly China, president of Lilly USA and president of Lilly Bio-Medicines. He earned a Bachelor of Science degree from Purdue University in 1990 and an MBA from Indiana University in 1996. Ricks also serves on the boards of Adobe, Business Roundtable, the Pharmaceutical Research and Manufacturers of America and the Purdue University Board of Trustees, which he joined in January 2025.

sentences.text: Dave Ricks, a Lilly veteran since 1996, became CEO in January 2017 and was elected chair of the board effective June 2017, so the chair and CEO roles are combined.
Company proxy materials credit his tenure with revenue growth of approximately 207% and a five-year total shareholder return of 571%, with 2025 revenue of $65.2 billion, up from $45 billion in 2024.

Capital allocation has tilted toward capacity, with capital expenditures of $7.8 billion in 2025 versus $5.1 billion in 2024, alongside a 15% increase in dividends paid per share and $7.0 billion remaining at mid-2026 under a $15.0 billion repurchase program authorized in December 2024.

citations.title: Eli Lilly Q2 2026 results: revenue +48%, raises guidance; retatrutide package complete

sentences.quote: Key Products revenue reached $15.7 billion in Q2, with Mounjaro ($9.943 billion, +91%) and Zepbound ($4.928 billion, +46%) leading growth.
sentences.text: Eli Lilly's incretin franchise is the core growth engine: Mounjaro revenue rose 91% to $9.9 billion and Zepbound 46% to $4.9 billion in Q2 2026, lifting total revenue 48% to $23.0 billion.
The oral GLP-1 Foundayo (orforglipron) won FDA approval on April 1, 2026 for obesity and overweight with weight-related conditions, with a U.S. submission also filed for type 2 diabetes.
International markets are scaling fast, as revenue outside the U.S. grew 80% to $8.6 billion on a 113% volume increase led by Mounjaro.
The pipeline extends beyond incretins, with Key Products in immunology, oncology and neuroscience up 121% and a retatrutide BLA planned for the first quarter of 2027.
Profitability is improving, with gross margin at 85.8% of revenue and 2026 revenue guidance raised to $85-87 billion.
